annotations.title: What a reader said about a subject

description:
Search one reader's own words in the Marginalia Corpus for a subject: their marginal notes, translations they wrote in, and (for Nietzsche and Derrida) their own published prose. The book author's printed lines are left out, so every hit is the reader speaking. Each hit carries the book, the page and its cite line.

Example questions:
- "What did Melville say about God in his margins?"
- "What did Nietzsche write about Wagner?"
- "What did Luther write about Christ in his books?"

subject.description: Words or a phrase to find in what they wrote, e.g. 'God', 'Wagner', 'whale'.
